description: This file defines a PHP class 'Recipient' within the OrangeHRM leave mail plugin, representing an email recipient with properties for email address, name, and first name, and corresponding accessor methods.

classes.name: Recipient
classes.description: A class representing an email recipient with email address, name, and first name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Recipient instance with email address, name, and first name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the recipient.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the recipient.
